name: DS Cluster D02: Reference Assets (Stocks, Indices, FX, Crypto)
description: Tests: reference_stocks, common_indices, fx_pairs, crypto_pairs with ^ prefix, relative strength pattern.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D02: Reference Assets
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === REFERENCE STOCK (curated) ===
spy_src = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()
spy_close = spy_src.c

# === REFERENCE STOCK (free-text) ===
qqq_src = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
qqq_close = qqq_src.c

# === INDEX (curated) ===
vix_src = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix = vix_src.c

# === RELATIVE STRENGTH ===
aapl_ret = returns(close)
spy_ret = returns(spy_close)
relative = aapl_ret - spy_ret
rel_cum = cumulative()(relative)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="AAPL vs SPY (Cumulative Relative Return)",
    category="Reference",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Relative", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Flat")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rel_cum)

xy_lines(
    title="VIX",
    category="Reference",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="VIX", color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=20, title="20 Level")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=vix)
